constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, matched_run_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs(company_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: workflow_message_intent_outcome
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((outcome IS NULL) OR (outcome = ANY (ARRAY['matched'::text, 'admitted'::text, 'none'::text, 'notification_source_retired'::text]))) AND ((outcome = 'matched'::text) = (matched_run_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: workflow_message_intent_reply_settled
constraints.definition: CHECK (((NOT reply_settled) OR ((reply_to_message_id IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'matched'::text))))

constraints.name: workflow_message_intent_reply_to
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, reply_to_message_id) REFERENCES messages(company_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: workflow_message_intent_responder
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, responder_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(company_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (responder_principal_id)

constraints.name: workflow_message_intent_state
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'pending'::text) AND (worker_id IS NULL) AND (claim_generation IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (attempts < 5)) OR ((state = 'claimed'::text) AND (worker_id IS NOT NULL) AND (claim_generation IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (attempts >= 1)) OR ((state = 'done'::text) AND (worker_id IS NULL) AND (claim_generation IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state = 'failed'::text) AND (worker_id IS NULL) AND (claim_generation IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL) AND (outcome IS NULL) AND (attempts = 5))))

constraints.name: workflow_parent_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((parent_run_id IS NULL) AND (parent_execution_id IS NULL)) OR ((parent_run_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_execution_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_run_id <> id))))

constraints.name: workflow_rerun_original_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, rerun_of_run_id, workflow_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs(company_id, id, workflow_id)

constraints.name: workflow_rerun_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK (((rerun_of_run_id IS NULL) OR ((parent_run_id IS NULL) AND (rerun_of_run_id <> id))))

constraints.name: workflow_run_parent_link_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, id, parent_run_id, parent_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_run_parents(company_id, child_run_id, parent_run_id, parent_execution_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: workflow_run_terminal_execution_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, id, terminal_execution_id) REFERENCES workflow_executions(company_id, run_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: workflow_run_waiting_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'waiting'::text) AND (waiting_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (waiting_reason = ANY (ARRAY['decision'::text, 'event'::text, 'timer'::text, 'child_run'::text, 'effect'::text, 'reconciliation'::text, 'agent_turn'::text]))) OR ((state <> 'waiting'::text) AND (waiting_reason IS NULL))))

constraints.name: workflow_runs_binding_revision_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, binding_id, binding_revision) REFERENCES workflow_binding_revisions(company_id, binding_id, revision)

constraints.name: workflow_runs_bundle_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, bundle_digest) REFERENCES workflow_bundles(company_id, digest) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: workflow_runs_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((thread_id IS NULL) OR (channel_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: workflow_runs_company_id_channel_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, channel_id) REFERENCES channels(company_id, id)

constraints.name: workflow_runs_company_id_channel_id_thread_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, channel_id, thread_id) REFERENCES threads(company_id, channel_id, id)

constraints.name: workflow_runs_company_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: workflow_runs_company_id_workflow_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, workflow_id, version_id) REFERENCES workflow_versions(company_id, workflow_id, id)
